Record Class AdocUnion.Result

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.plugin.adoc.AdocUnion.Result
Record Components:
copied - external libraries copied from their zip
linked - reactor members linked, or copied from their tree when linking is off
unchanged - libraries already in the union as they are
legacy - legacy libraries unpacked into the legacy directory
Enclosing class:
AdocUnion
